text:
mike_cs: heads up — Solstice Labs is evaluating moving two new pods (Taxonomy + Compliance) onto Redwood. They flagged heavy batch embed needs and want a proof-of-concept for low-latency assistants. renewal in ~2 months.

nina_sales: do they have numbers? how big is "heavy"?

mike_cs: client expects initial bulk ingest ~1.5M docs, then steady-state ~20k embed updates/week. Realtime assistant load estimate ~200 rps peak internal. Also asked about private deployment options for Compliance team.

diego_se: tagging SE — big batch + high-rps assistant means we should propose Dedicated or Private. @ops_bot what's their current plan?

ops_bot: Solstice Labs account snapshot:
 Plan: Standard Hosted
 Dedicated: none
 30d peak tokens: 1.6M/day
 Suggestion: Offer 3-month Dedicated pilot or Private evaluation for Compliance.

nina_sales: i'll work with finance to draft a pricing scenario for a 6-month reserved commit. Would like SE sizing to backfill.

mike_cs: onboarding asks: create embedding hygiene guide + workshop for retriever tuning. Also request sample PII handling note if considering Private.

diego_se: tech todo:
- sizing doc for Dedicated pool (start 3x A100 equiv, autoscale)
- recommend async ingestion pattern + backpressure for 1.5M docs
- plan for KV prefix caching to reduce assistant latency
- quantify storage costs with quantized vectors

ops_bot: ticket #CS-9105 created for Solstice Labs expansion preflight. SE: diego_se. Sales opp estimated 58% within 6 weeks.

mike_cs: action items: nina - draft commercial by Tue; diego - deliver sizing by Wed; I'll request sample data and compliance questions from client.

nina_sales: on it. any objections to including Private trial as a commercial line-item?

diego_se: include it but flag infra onboarding lead time. Private trials need a different ops track.

mike_cs: agreed. main risk is hitting soft limits on embedding throughput; ensure we recommend safe early-stage throttles.

ops_bot: Reminder: attach eval rubric and workshop agenda to ticket CS-9105.

mike_cs: thanks all, will follow up after CS-9105 is populated. :rocket:
